verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The constant (−M⁻¹)^p, the power ∂_U^p, the p-fold inverse and the full-line integral over the translated line all match, and in totalIntegral_sourceJet the integral is at the paper's own point: totalIntegral M v f (U,y) = ∫ f(U+u, y+Muv_r) du with v = vector d = v_r. The paper's one display is the composition of three Lean statements rather than one: totalIntegral_sourceJet carries the identity for an abstract right inverse J of v_r·∂_y (smooth, radially supported on each iterate — the Lean form of the paper's 'every endpoint term vanishes by compact support'); fourierSourceJet_eq_parameterJet, with sourceJet_eq_deriv_inverse_iterate, identifies the iterate with the concrete ∂_U^p 𝓛^{-p} of the torus Fourier inverse; and totalIntegral_nonbarPart is the passage from F to F^∘ under the paper's vanishing weighted moment. Each step is a rewriting. wholeAlias_inverse_iterate states the same identity with the integration variable translated (take Y = y − MUv_r).
